subject: MAP checkpoint: pricing path to commit
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: MAP checkpoint: pricing path to commit

Hi Julie / Stellar team,

Quick MAP checkpoint following Friday's demo. High-level status: pilot completed, evaluation signals look good (latency and cost metrics shared in Drive). We want to align on commercial path to close this month.

Open asks from your side:
- Confirm target commit size and preferred payment cadence (annual prepay vs. monthly).
- Procurement: any non-standard T&Cs we should expect in the PO?

Redwood asks (what we need to finalize internal approvals):
- Formal budget signal (OK to request discount & pilot credit) by EOD 11/18 so we can route to finance/CRO.
- Confirmation that the pilot scope maps to the production workloads (we nominated 3 endpoints).

Initial pricing ask we discussed on call: 12-month commit, $120k ARR target. Customer requested discount/credit; I flagged this to pricing. I attached the draft SOW and a one-page pricing summary for reference.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal review (pricing + finance) — target 11/16
2) Updated commercial terms sent to procurement — target 11/16 afternoon
3) DocuSign + PO in hand — target 11/18

I appreciate speedy feedback — I want to keep the momentum and avoid slipping to December.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx, pricing-summary.csv

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: pricing path to commit

Soojin —
Re: pricing levers we can use to get this over the line quickly:
- Base discount: we can offer 15% off list for a 12-month commit at $120k ARR.
- One-time pilot credit: $15,000 (applies at contract execution; cannot be split).
- Payment terms: annual prepay preferred (gives best PS/discount profile); we can support monthly billing with net-30 but that lowers discount by 3 percentage points.

Constraints / approvals needed:
- CRO sign-off required for any discount >15% or credit >$15k.
- Finance needs a forecasted start date and expected invoice cadence by 11/18 EOD to calendar the commit.

If Julie confirms $120k ARR and annual prepay, I'm green to approve the 15% + $15k credit. If she asks for 18% + $25k credit we'll need CRO and finance escalation (timeline slips).

Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@stellarhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: pricing path to commit

Julie / Procurement —
Following internal review, we can proceed with the following commercial proposal to close this month:

- Commit: $120,000 ARR (12 months)
- Discount: 15% off published rates
- One-time pilot credit: $15,000 applied at contract start
- Payment: annual prepay (preferred). If you require monthly billing, discount will be 12% (3 point reduction).
- Data handling: pilot data will be archived and retained per contract; we are happy to confirm retention window in the SOW (default 90 days post-contract unless otherwise specified).

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1_redline.pdf (includes the updated billing section and retention note). If that looks good, I can produce a DocuSign package with the pricing terms and SOW for procurement next steps.

Next actions:
- Julie: confirm payment cadence and procurement preferred contact for PO (target: 11/16 EOD)
- Procurement: send redline / non-standard clauses back (if any) — target: 11/17
- Redwood (Karthik/Finance): standing by to finalize invoice schedule once procurement confirms

Thanks — aiming to get DocuSign live by 11/17 so we can capture signature and PO by 11/18 as discussed.

Best,
Soojin
From: Procurement Team <procure@stellarhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julie Park <julie.park@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: pricing path to commit

Soojin —
Thanks for the update. Attached is our redline of the SOW (see Redwood_SOW_v1_redline.pdf). Key asks from procurement:
- Add an SLA clause for uptime (we will provide target language)
- Clarify data jurisdiction and encryption at rest language
- Provide a single total contract value to include credits/discounts for PO (we need a dollar figure for the PO)

We can issue a PO once we have the final DocuSign package and the total contract value. Julie will coordinate the PO internally; her team prefers annual prepay.

Please send the DocuSign link and the final T&Cs so we can route for signature.

Regards,
Stellar Health Procurement
procure@stellarhealth.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1_redline.pdf
